PILOT BRIEFING

Instructions & controls

Follow the delta to 1,000,000 points. Clear bridge control towers, choose either channel around islands, and watch for fast jets crossing from the banks. Every bridge is a checkpoint.

Fly the aircraft

A D bank and turn
W climb · S dive
← → bank and turn
↑ nose down · ↓ nose up

Speed control — hold the key

E accelerate
Q brake
SHIFT turbo boost
Release E / Q to return to cruising speed.
Boost recharges when released and uses extra fuel.

Make every pass count

SPACE hold for cannons
F launch a missile
Aim toward a target to lock on.
Green rings refuel below 23 m.

Pause & sound

ESC / P pause or resume
M toggle sound
Open Instructions anytime to review controls.
Your flight pauses while you read.

Fly with the touch stick

Drag the left stick forward (up) to dive.
Pull it back (down) to climb.
Drag left or right to bank and turn.
Release to center the stick.

Speed & weapons

Hold BOOST to accelerate; release to recharge.
Hold FIRE for cannons. Tap MISSILE to launch.
Steer and use the buttons at the same time.
Green rings refuel below 23 m.

Pause & sound

Tap the pause icon to pause the flight.
Tap the speaker icon to mute or enable sound.
Opening Instructions pauses the game.

Three aircraft. An extra life every 10,000 points (up to nine). Fuel and damage carry between bridges; collect green depots. Bridges supply two missiles and save progress. Controller: left stick to fly, RT cannons, A missile, LT boost. On touch screens, use the on-screen controls.
